environments_list.description: Deployed environments of a project (dev/staging/prod) with provider, region, selectors and whether a credential is configured. Start here to get an environment_id.

discover_resources.description: Inventory an environment's cloud resources. AWS: load balancers, ECS services, Lambdas, RDS, log groups. GCP: Cloud Run services, HTTPS load balancers, GKE clusters, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, log names. Each resource carries `suggested` metric sources per signal — copy them verbatim, including `unit` and `scale`. Does NOT decide which resource is this project's — correlate with the repo's deploy config yourself.

metrics_query.description: Time series for explicit metric sources. The source shape depends on the environment's provider — AWS: {namespace, metric_name, dimensions, stat}; GCP: {metric_type, filter, aligner, reducer}. Use discover_resources to get well-formed ones rather than writing them by hand.

params.sources: AWS: [{namespace, metric_name, dimensions, stat}]. GCP: [{metric_type, filter, aligner, reducer}].

error_groups.description: Exceptions grouped by message with counts and first/last seen — CloudWatch Logs Insights on AWS, Error Reporting (falling back to Cloud Logging) on GCP. The highest-value signal here: a group with a recent first_seen and a rising count is a regression pointing at specific code.

params.log_groups: Defaults to the environment's log_group selectors

logs_search.description: Search logs. On AWS `query` is a CloudWatch Logs Insights query; on GCP it is a Cloud Logging filter (e.g. `severity >= "ERROR" AND resource.labels.service_name="api"`) — different languages, so check the environment's provider first. Output is capped: narrow the window rather than raising the cap.

params.query: AWS: Logs Insights query. GCP: Cloud Logging filter. Default: recent messages, newest first.

deploys.description: Deployment markers in a window, so a metric change can be attributed to a release. Without these, correlation is guesswork. Implemented on GCP (Cloud Run revision creation times); on AWS it reports itself as unavailable rather than returning a misleading empty list.

errors.no_credential: no Thulu credential was forwarded with this call — the agent's key rides on the MCP handshake (X-API-Key); this server holds none of its own
errors.environment_not_linked: environment {environment} belongs to project {project}, which is not linked to task {task}
errors.no_credential_granted: no credential is granted to environment {environment}. Grant one on the Credentials page ("Reachable from" → this environment).
errors.credential_provider_mismatch: credential "{credential}" is a {credential_provider} key but environment {environment} is {provider}. Grant a {provider} credential to it instead.
errors.aws_keys_incomplete: aws_keys credential is missing access_key_id or secret_access_key
errors.aws_role_unsupported: aws_role credentials are not supported yet — use aws_keys
errors.credential_kind_not_aws: environment {environment} has credential kind '{kind}', expected aws_keys
errors.aws_only: this tool only supports provider 'aws'; environment is '{provider}'
errors.provider_unsupported: {tool} supports providers {providers}; environment {environment} is '{provider}'. Nothing will be collected for it until that provider is implemented.
errors.credential_kind_not_gcp: environment {environment} has credential kind '{kind}', expected gcp_sa for a GCP environment
errors.service_account_incomplete: service account JSON is missing client_email or private_key
errors.gcp_project_unknown: cannot tell which GCP project to query — the key file has no project_id; set the environment's `account` field to the project id
errors.divide_by_empty: divide_by {metric} returned no usable value for any bucket
errors.no_log_groups: no log groups — pass log_groups, or set a `log_group` selector on the environment
errors.sources_empty: sources must be a non-empty array
errors.tool_not_allowed: tool '{name}' is not in the allowed tool list for this session
errors.tool_scope_required: tool '{name}' requires scope '{required}', this session has '{scope}'
errors.handshake_no_key: an MCP session needs the run's key on the handshake (X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer)
errors.message_key_mismatch: this message does not carry the key its session was opened with
errors.list_only_session: this session was opened without a credential: it can list tools, not call them
errors.collect_target_missing: collect needs the environment and its credential in the body: the daemon resolves them and sends them (this server holds no key to ask for them)

text.truncated: […{label} truncated: {bytes} more bytes omitted by thulu-cloud]
text.gap_probe_failed: could not enumerate {kind}: {error} — this is NOT evidence the resource is absent. Do not mark any signal not_applicable on account of it; report the access gap instead.
text.gap_aws_no_serving: no load balancer or Lambda found — latency and error rate have no obvious source
text.gap_lambda_without_gateway: Lambdas but no API Gateway visible: error_rate from AWS/Lambda Errors misses handled 5xx and every 4xx rejected at the edge, so a total auth outage would show a green dashboard
text.gap_no_log_groups: no log groups visible — error_groups and logs_search will not work
text.gap_gcp_no_serving: no Cloud Run service, HTTPS load balancer or Cloud Function found — latency, error_rate and throughput have no obvious source
text.gap_no_gke: no GKE cluster — `restarts` has no source on this environment (Cloud Run does not expose it)
text.gap_gcp_cost: cost_daily is not readable from an API on GCP: billing detail lives in a BigQuery export the account owner must enable. Leave that signal unmapped.
text.error_reporting_empty: Error Reporting returned no groups for this window; grouped ERROR-severity log entries instead
text.gke_narrow_filter: narrow `filter` with resource.labels.namespace_name and container_name before proposing a mapping

deploys_truncated.one: {count} more Cloud Run service was not scanned (fan-out cap)
deploys_truncated.other: {count} more Cloud Run services were not scanned (fan-out cap)

text.deploys_none: no Cloud Run revision was created in this window; GKE and Cloud Functions deploys are not read yet
text.deploys_aws_unavailable: deploy markers are not wired for AWS yet. Thulu knows when each PR merged — use that as the approximation until CodeDeploy events are connected.

collect_no_usable_source.one: the {count} active mapping has no source shaped for provider '{provider}'
collect_no_usable_source.other: none of the {count} active mapping(s) has a source shaped for provider '{provider}'
